title: expectrail.repro-hand-reasons/v1
description: Hand findings for defects of the public reproduction bench whose miss no run's records can classify (issue #285, step 2): why the defect leaves the engine's record unchanged on every library probe. Written by hand, read by expectrail.repro.breakdown. A finding replaces only a scorer's 'undetermined' and never changes whether a defect was reproduced.

written.description: The date the findings were made. Not checked.

id.description: A defect id of the bench.

reason.description: Only the two reasons of the issue's vocabulary that no record separates. The others are the scorer's.

basis.description: What was seen, in one line.
